summary: Iteration 9 — validated variant sale_price + coa_url + COA-pending pre-order flow. Backend 5/5 pytest cases PASS. Frontend visually verified: product detail (5mg sale $49.99 with COA link, 10mg pre-order $85.00 with PRE-ORDER · $85.00 CAD button), catalog SALE + PRE-ORDER badges + strikethrough, FR translation 'PRIX SPÉCIAL', admin editor exposes v-sale-price-0/v-coa-url-0 inputs. Backend charges the correct effective price per variant and does NOT decrement stock for COA-pending pre-orders even when stock > 0.
tests_executed: * test_product_variants_expose_sale_and_coa: GET /api/products/bpc-157-5mg returns sale_price=49.99, coa_url on 5mg; preorder_enabled+badge_coa_pending+preorder_price=85 on 10mg
* test_checkout_5mg_uses_sale_price_and_decrements: interac checkout charges 49.99 (not 64.99), items[0].preorder=False, has_preorder=False, stock decremented by 1

* test_checkout_10mg_is_preorder_no_stock_decrement: interac checkout for COA-pending variant with stock > 0 succeeds, charges 85.00, items[0].preorder=True, order.has_preorder=True, fulfillment_status='preorder', stock UNCHANGED
* test_admin_update_persists_sale_and_coa: admin login → PUT /api/admin/products/{id} with modified variants persists sale_price + coa_url; restore worked
* test_zzz_cleanup: created orders removed, 5mg stock restored

* Product /product/bpc-157-5mg 5mg default: data-testid=product-original-price='$64.99' (strikethrough), product-price='$49.99', product-discount-badge='SPECIAL PRICE −23%', download-coa href starts with example.com/coa ✓

* Variant switch to 10.0mg via data-testid='variant-10.0mg': product-original-price='$100.00', product-price='$85.00', product-discount-badge='PRE-ORDER PRICE −15%', CTA reads 'PRE-ORDER · $85.00 CAD', 'Lock in the pre-order price' hint visible ✓
* Cart LocalStorage (nordpep_cart_v1): 10mg line stored with price_cad=85 (correct pre-order price)

* Admin /admin → ADMIN header button auto-login → Products → edit-bpc-157-5mg → editor shows v-sale-price-0 value=49.99, v-coa-url-0 value=https://example.com/coa-bpc157-5mg.pdf, labels 'Special price (sale)' and 'COA URL (PDF)' ✓

critical_code_review_comments: server.py _variant_effective_price (line 460) correctly prefers preorder_price when is_preorder, falls back to sale_price when sale < price, else base price — logic sound.

server.py _build_order_totals (line 481-491) marks is_preorder=True whenever variant.preorder_enabled AND (badge_coa_pending or badge_coming_soon) — even with stock > 0 → correct COA-pending pre-order semantics.
server.py stock decrement (line 806-816) skips increment when it['preorder']==True → matches spec: pre-order line items must not consume inventory. Verified by test.
server.py fulfillment_status set to 'preorder' when has_preorder=True (line 792) — correct.
ProductVariant model exposes sale_price/coa_url — admin PUT round-trips these fields correctly via ProductIn (validated by test).
